-Fun Discord link!

notes.title: Boxes O' All Sizes Update!
notes.notes:
Woah! A new update full of awesome presents! Before the Holidays! Where did this come from!?

[b]Enhanced Controller Support[/b]
Sole Iron Tail has been upgraded to use the ReWired controller library. What does that mean for you? Well, not only are controllers much more easily detected, SIT should now work with most DirectInput, Playstation, Switch, etc. controllers without the need to adjust things on Steam! Playstation/Switch icons coming soon!

[b]Boxes O' All Sizes![/b]
What's up with that update name? Well aside from presents of all shapes and sizes, Sole Iron Tail has finally received support for all aspect ratios! And this isn't just for 16:10 champs! Have some retro monitor thats in *GASP* 4:3?!?! BAM, SIT supports it! Have a cool ultrawide that you just wish more games supported? BAM, SIT supports that too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/10e9cdf6cf53e38473ecd349ad9516559a68877d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/1385da3cee658b1fc1b72ccc81d5cccb0c528c30.png[/img]

[b]Linux Support![/b]
Welcome my penguin brothers and sisters! You can now slip and slide on linux!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/a94381b25f45c5f940876affb698d94d7ae8be79.png[/img]

[b]What are you hiding...[/b]
So there is a pattern with all these updates. Ultimately, Sole Iron Tail is now SUPER DUPER UPGRADED FOR DECK. For those getting one next year, you'll have a super fun time with Deck-Enhanced SIT!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/c187d077cab4d0ae88f053cdb73f7d55c454e7f3.jpg[/img]

[b]The little-big present![/b]
Sole Iron Tail is on 30% discount during the holiday sale! Even if you've already got the game, give it another look. The Iron Tail got a new hat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/975f56f4197dd3e2c371dd2731f9dc40b782ed79.png[/img]



You've reached the end of this update! Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Sole Iron Tail Pre-Release Newsletter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/38eef51ac9a55fba8a3ab6bd0e330565ed758148.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/94b286ab7eb783e058dc61ff2c797286a75c6808.png[/img]

[b]Releasing November 9th![/b]
With the release of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PVMK9AVTYt4]the most recent trailer[/url] last month, Sole Iron Tail's release has been announced for November 9th! Please spread this news where you can!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/f88e6a85541cf05195df0a56e6b9237139140e6c.png[/img]

[b]Tonsa Tweaks[/b]
Each level has received a ton of tweaks, fixes, and "glow ups" (am I cool yet?) thanks to the many awesome playtesters testing the game in the past month. These levels will definitely feel more polished, free-flowing, and slipp-ier/slide-ier!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/a698f37923ed372b84e6ea2e84d1161c3689635f.png[/img]

[b]Beyond the story...[/b]
With so many levels, scarves, bosses, and badges, the average completionist will have tons to do! For you guys, I have a little treat past 100%




[b]Thank You![/b]
For everyone who’s been sticking with this project since early 2019 to newcomers just reading this newsletter, I want to give a big super duper thanks for looking at my little project. Throughout the project i’ve had moments, some fun, many fantastic, though still with a few challenges along the way. Regardless, working on this game has been a treat, and I am super proud of what it has become (and what you will get to try out soon!). So to all mailing listers, wishlisters, playtesters, mentors, past co-developers (Ellen for art and +TEK/H-Mister for music), and other cool people, thank you!

-Manny Mallea

Have a happy Halloween and enjoy the game!
